title: Pattern-Extraction---From-Repos---AST-Practice
summary: A personal AST/call-graph pattern-extraction practice tool that mines code clusters from other GitHub repositories and stores them as output files. One extracted cluster is copied source from the sdgx (synthetic-data-generator) project, whose CTGANSynthesizerModel and GaussianCopulaSynthesizerModel classes directly wrap the standalone ctgan and copulas packages from the SDV family.
evidence: cluster_9.py:1931 'class GaussianCopulaSynthesizerModel ... wrapping copulas.multivariate.GaussianMultivariate'; cluster_3.py:38 'from sdgx.models.ml.single_table.ctgan import CTGANSynthesizerModel'
needs: Repository only extracts/copies code from third-party repos (e.g. sdgx) for AST practice; the SDV-family code is inherited vendored text, never executed by this repo itself.
